title: Karabasan's Gift
summary: Single-use grenade. Its thrown form causes a distinct, more dangerous kind of paralysis.

fields.Throw: Use an Action. Creatures in the 6.5 ft radius must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or become Paralysed for 2 turns.
fields.Thrown paralysis: Incapacitated. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves and is Vulnerable to Slashing, Piercing and Bludgeoning damage. Attacks from within 10 ft automatically hit and critically hit.
fields.Drink: Use a Bonus Action to ingest it yourself. After 1 turn, gain ordinary Paralysed for 2 turns. Ordinary paralysis prevents movement, actions, bonus actions and reactions. Attacks against you have Advantage and hits within 10 ft are critical. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves.
fields.Acquisition: Find it in the House of Healing Morgue laboratory at X 15, Y −988, or pickpocket Sister Sinda at the House of Healing.
fields.Base value: 150 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
